ground_truth.cause: In batch, audit-exporter emits scripted ERROR upstream gateway timeout messages every 0.1 seconds. It makes no dependency requests.
ground_truth.impact: This is log noise, not evidence of a gateway or shop service outage.
ground_truth.mitigation: Stop or correct the noisy audit-exporter logging behavior, or explicitly recommend no operational repair because no service fault is present. Under this rubric no remedial proposal receives none; it is not automatically a supported mitigation. Do not restart or scale an alleged upstream gateway.
